# Vendored browser cryptography

Generated by `npm run crypto:vendor` from the pinned package-lock installation.
Noble ES-module imports are rewritten to local relative URLs; cryptographic code
and upstream whitespace are otherwise retained. `manifest.json` records both
upstream source and published byte hashes, verified in the test suite.

Sources: `@noble/post-quantum` 0.7.1, `@noble/ciphers` 2.4.0,
`@noble/hashes` 2.4.0, transitive `@noble/curves` 2.4.0 (MIT), and
`hash-wasm` 4.12.0 (MIT, with embedded Argon2 attribution in its license).
The adjacent license files must be retained when redistributing these modules.

The Argon2 module is the unchanged upstream ESM distribution, with embedded WASM.
No runtime CDN, external module URL, application bundler or downloaded-at-runtime
cryptographic code is used.
